queries.name: CAVAS_REGISTRY_POST_AUDIT_R2
queries.sql:
SELECT
    CAST(id AS varchar(36)) AS server_id,
    nombre,
    host,
    port,
    database_name,
    username,
    activo
FROM dbo.Servidores_Conexiones
WHERE id = CAST('8016ab53-f1ef-4539-aebe-c01e5b978bbc' AS uniqueidentifier)

objective: Corregir exclusivamente database_name del registro CAVAS de cava_www a cavas_www mediante SERVER_REGISTRY_METADATA_UPDATE, preservando id, activo, username, host, port y secretos.
